title: Lip Therapy Duo Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Ceramide✓ Clean at Sephora✓ High Shine Finish✓ Hyaluronic Acid
What it is: A perfect pairing for instant lip therapy, featuring Gisou’s Honey Glaze Collagen Therapy Lip Mask and Honey Infused Lip Oil in Honey Gold.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Hydrates and boosts shine.

What Else You Need to Know: This set includes two honey-infused lip products for instant lip therapy.

This Set Contains:
- 0.27 oz/ 8 mL Honey Infused Lip Oil in Honey Gold
- 0.52 oz/ 15 g Honey Glaze Lip Mask

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils. Learn more How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Combined:
-Apply a generous layer of Honey Glaze Lip Mask, then layer with Honey Infused Lip Oil in your preferred shade for a tint of color and glossy shine.

Honey Glaze Lip Mask:
-Glide on with the lip-hugging applicator.
-Apply throughout the day for instant hydration and glazed shine.
-Use as an overnight treatment for restored, smoother-looking lips.

Honey Infused Lip Oil:
-Pucker up and swipe on with the lip-hugging applicator for honey-kissed lips that shine with hydration.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Hydrates and boosts shine.

Lip Oil HG:
Polyglyceryl-2 Isostearate/Dimer Dilinoleate Copolymer, Dilinoleic Acid/Propanediol Copolymer, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil,
Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Mauritia Flexuosa (Buriti) Fruit Oil, Calendula Officinalis (Marigold) Flower Extract, Hydrogenated Castor Oil/Sebacic Acid Copolymer, Tocopherol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Fruit Oil, Vaccinium Myrtillus Seed Oil, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Trihydroxystearin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glucomannan, Aroma (Flavor), Parfum (Fragrance), Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Citral**, Eugenol**, Geraniol**, Linalool**, Citronellol**, Limonene**, Benzyl Benzoate**, Hexyl Cinnamal**, Linalyl Acetate**, Terpineol**.

Lip Mask:
Hydrogenated Poly (C6-14 Olefin), Diisostearyl Malate, Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Synthetic Wax, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer, Isostearic Acid, Sucrose Tetrastearate Triacetate, Dilinoleic Acid/Propanediol Copolymer, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax, Glycerin, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Ceramide NP, Sodium Hyaluronate, Isostearoyl Hydrolyzed Collagen, Tocopherol, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Mauritia Flexuosa Fruit Oil, Calendula Officinalis (Marigold) Flower Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Fruit Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Trihydroxystearin, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Isopropyl Titanium Triisostearate, Glucomannan, Aroma (Flavor), Parfum (Fragrance), Citral**, Eugenol**, Geraniol**, Linalool**, Citronellol**, Limonene**, Terpineol**, Iron Oxides (CI 77492).

*Honey sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden. ** Naturally occurring allergens.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
